sigma.gain_reference: relative to the bed's RMS level

notes: loudness is K-weighted integrated, UNGATED (BS.1770 gating omitted in the proof build, stated not hidden).
section levels RMS-matched to the median section, clamped to +/-6 dB, before crossfading.
2 s tail fade + 5 ms head fade applied before mastering.

stereo law: musicgen-small renders mono, and the stitched bed starts dual-mono; the Stereo Law answers in three parts -- the spine is panned by role (kick and 808 centered, hats and rim wide), the bed is widened by quadrature side synthesis above 180 Hz with the mid preserved exactly and the lows left fully mono, and the Sigma layer is never processed. The widths are measured in the stereo block, not claimed.
spine: the rhythmic spine is RESONANTIA's own synthesis on the resonance.grid arithmetic -- whole bars, exact samples; the bed was trimmed in LENGTH to that grid, never tempo-shifted.

motif: every bed section prompt carries the spec's motif verbatim -- 'the same repeating four-note F minor piano motif (F, A-flat, C, A-flat)' -- the anti-Frankenstein law: one named figure in every dream the bed dreams.
crossfades: 2 whole bars each (168175 samples) -- seams on bar lines, not the legacy 2 s.

chained bed: every section after the first was generated CONTINUED from the tail of its predecessor (5.0 s of audio conditioning) -- one performance, section by section; each segment's continued_from stands in the render report.

arpeggio: the composed violin layer is RESONANTIA's own composition -- the solfeggio ladder in Fibonacci phrases, humanized and orbited; its inventory stands in the arpeggio block, its notation in composition.abc.
